dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm looking for a new pair of running shoes. Do you have any recommendations that are waterproof and within my budget of $50 to $100?
dialogue.agent:
I found several options that match your criteria for waterproof running shoes within your budget. Here are a few recommendations:

1. **"adidas Men's Solarthon Primegreen Spikeless Golf Shoes"** - Price: $90.16, Rating: 4.6, Reviews: 43
   - Description: Inspired by long summer days, these golf shoes prioritize comfort. From the Boost midsole for an energized feel to a soft, breathable upper, they support your feet from the front nine to the back and beyond. The lightweight, water-repellent design keeps feet dry and comfortable. A spikeless outsole grips the green and ensures easy transitions off the course. This product is made with Primegreen, a series of high-performance recycled materials.

2. **"Saucony Men's Peregrine 8 ICE+ Sneaker"** - Price: $68.52, Rating: 4.6, Reviews: 6
   - Description: Featuring vibrant Artic grip outsole, the peregrine 8 ice+ turns cold weather from an excuse to a bonus. The proprietary outsole compound utilizes wet ice tech to keep you pushing the pace without slipping, and Everun cushioning ensures you can lay fresh tracks for miles. Saucony is among the most respected names in running shoes. We offer a wide range of running and walking shoes, each with the Saucony trademark fit, feel and performance. We've spent years studying the biomechanics of top athletes. Our goal? To develop creatively engineered systems that maximize your performance in your specific activity, allowing you to focus on the activity instead of the equipment. From our studies have come many innovative Saucony concepts. Advanced technologies-like Grid, the first sole-based stability and cushioning system--provide an advantage to athletes of all types.

3. **"Columbia Kids' Youth Drainmaker IV Water Shoe"** - Price: $60.85, Rating: 4.6, Reviews: 16
   - Description: Your kid will think it’s cool that this hybrid shoe literally drains water, while you can feel good knowing it’s quick drying, lightweight, and super supportive for their little feet. This ideal all-season sneaker keeps little feet happy with a combination of mesh and textile upper that delivers comfort and functionality for all day wear. The TechLite cupsole midsole delivers long lasting support, while the Omni-Grip non-marking traction rubber offers great dockside to pavement performance. Columbia offers these kids shoes in multiple colors, with true-to-size fit.

products.title: Timberland Adventure Seeker Closed-Toe Sandal (Toddler/Little Kid)
products.description: Help them stay comfortable throughout spring with the exceptional Timberland Adventure Seeker Closed Toe Youth Sandal, formerly called the Mad River Sandal. Great for everyday wear, their little feet will stay comfortable and protected all-day long thanks to its EVA footbed and rubber outsole. Boasting of a lightweight and water-friendly upper, it features two adjustable straps with hook-and-loop closure for a great fit. Sanitized anti-microbial treatment helps keep their feet comforted and odor-free all-day long. Make this summer one to remember with the new Timberland Adventure Seeker Closed Toe Sandal Youth Timberland set new industry standards for craftsmanship, durability and protection when it introduced an authentic, waterproof leather boot in 1973. A global leader in design, engineering and marketing of premium footwear, Timberland values consumers who cherish the outdoors and their time in it. Timberland has been an industry leader in the use of both sustainable and recycled materials in its shoes, as well as its footwear packaging. The Timberland Company believes in corporate responsibility and supports numerous civic and social projects throughout the year.

products.title: Baffin Women's Snosport Hiking Boot
products.description: Twenty-five years ago Baffin Footwear began manufacturing insulated and non-insulated footwear products. While traditional molded boots are suitable for some conditions, they are not ideal for cold temperatures. Baffin combines leading molding technology with a foam-based inner boot system, which creates a hybrid style of high-performance footwear. This equates to more warmth, better fit, and superior comfort. Baffin boots are different than most shoes and work boots because the sole and midsole are molded to the base in one continuous process. The sole itself is a marvel of modern engineering because it is made up of several advanced thermo-set polymers that are combined together to achieve the right balance of warmth, protection, low weight and grip. Baffin is dedicated to offering boots with functionality and fashion, while still maintaining their legendary performance.

products.title: Under Armour Women's Jet Low Golf Shoe
